analysis: The only change in this PR (docs/architecture/inference.md, head lines 2966-2970) is documentation. It says the control leader's cluster service re-plans and re-adopts the same model after a Darkbloom update only once both Macs report the same worker build (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild`). It also links the pair's coordinated update in provider/cluster-always-on.md. The changed hunk lies outside the two supplied units, which are unchanged surrounding text at head lines 3588-4068. I examined those units for context and found nothing security-relevant introduced by this PR. No code, keys, authorization logic, attestation logic, encryption logic, endpoint or configuration changes are included. The descriptive text covers sealed AES-256-GCM all-sums, the owner-only probe files, the prefix-cache tenant partitions (cf. T-041) and the worker-build scoping of served-speed records. All of it is existing prose and reaches no new trust boundary. The 'oneBuild' gate is a liveness and availability behavior (avoiding a 600 s failed plan) and does not weaken the authorization, attestation or per-request encryption controls in the supplied threat model. Remaining unverified items: the claimed `oneBuild` behavior in ClusterOnboardingUpdate and the linked cluster-always-on.md anchor are outside the supplied evidence. This review does not validate them, nor the rest of the doc's behavioral claims. I conclude that no security regression or threat-model gap arises from this PR.
